name: a doctype and html with attributes
doc:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" data-theme="light"><head><meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; font-src data:"><base target="_blank"><title>x</title></head><body>hi</body></html>

name: an existing data-theme is replaced
doc: <html lang="en" data-theme="dark"><head><meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; font-src data:"><base target="_blank"></head><body></body></html>

name: uppercase tags
doc: <HTML data-theme="dark"><HEAD><meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; font-src data:"><base target="_blank"><TITLE>x</TITLE></HEAD><BODY></BODY></HTML>

name: html without a head gets one
doc: <!doctype html><html data-theme="light"><head><meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; font-src data:"><base target="_blank"></head><body>x</body></html>

name: meta refresh and other http-equiv metas are removed
doc: <html data-theme="light"><head><meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; font-src data:"><base target="_blank"><meta charset="utf-8"></head><body></body>

name: a head inside a comment is not the head
doc: <html data-theme="dark"><head><meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; font-src data:"><base target="_blank"></head><body></body></html>

name: a header tag is not a head
doc: <html data-theme="dark"><head><meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; font-src data:"><base target="_blank"></head><body><header>x</header></body></html>
